{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08

|arg= global

|gr1= PhysX

|descr= Returns the status of autobrake (see [[disableBrakes]]).

|s1= [[brakesDisabled]] transport

|p1= transport: [[Object]] - PhysX car or tank

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if autobrake is disabled

|x1= <sqf>
if !(brakesDisabled _vehicle) then
{
	_vehicle disableBrakes true;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[disableBrakes]] [[awake]] [[isAwake]] [[addTorque]] [[addForce]] [[vectorModelToWorld]] [[vectorModelToWorldVisual]] [[selectionPosition]] [[setVelocityTransformation]] [[setVelocityModelSpace]]
